info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Management API allows businesses to efficiently update and manage account risk parameters. This operation is aimed at financial institutions and risk management teams that require dynamic adjustments to counterparty risk profiles based on evolving data. By utilizing specific risk parameters, users can ensure compliance with regulatory standards and enhance decision-making processes. Typical use cases include updates in response to market changes, client status alterations, or internal policy adjustments.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of counterparty risk data for a specific party identified by its unique ID. Ensure all relevant fields are provided in the request to update the counterparty risk accurately.

requestBody.description: Updates the counterparty risk details for the specified party. The request body should contain the necessary information required to modify the existing counterparty risk record.
